About the position

This position is part of the Director for Test Organization and is within the Department of Defense Acquisition Workforce Personnel Demonstration Project (AcqDemo). The incumbent provides input to acquisition decisions by assessing the adequacy of test and evaluation programs and evaluating test results. The role supports space capabilities by helping ensure opportunities to collect mission-critical data and by developing and executing test strategies and plans to validate asset requirements while accommodating unique collection opportunities. The incumbent also coordinates testing and performance analysis with contractors and partner agencies, supports anomaly resolution and integration, and communicates test status, results, issues, and risks to leadership.\n\nThe position is classified at the NH-0801/1515-3 broadband level. It is a full-time, exempt acquisition position coded Practitioner in Test and Evaluation. The incumbent must obtain the required DoD Acquisition Test and Evaluation Practitioner certification within 60 months of entering the position and earn 80 Continuous Learning Points every 24 months. The position requires a Special Sensitive/Top Secret/SCI security clearance and is subject to initial and random drug testing. Situational telework may be available at management's discretion.

jobs_results.description:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We're a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies - collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation's health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose - and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

This is an opportunity for a motivated Operations Research Analyst to join MITRE's Operations Analysis department. We are a large group of over 60 operations research professionals, including over 20 PhDs, who provide thought leadership on a variety of strategic and technical issues, perform analysis that enable our sponsors to make more effective decisions, lead internal research and development activities to bring new technical capabilities into the public sector, and serve as trusted third-party advisors to government sponsors on a variety of technical topics. 

In short, we apply our problem-solving skills to complex interdisciplinary problems that occur within or at the intersection of organizations, operations, and technology.  We support sponsor projects across the defense and public sectors including homeland defense, military logistics, radio-spectrum frequency management, health care delivery, cybersecurity analytics, fraud detection, satellite planning, homeland security and civilian aviation. We apply advanced analytic techniques such as longitudinal analysis, large-scale integer programming, metaheuristics, agent-based modeling, reinforcement learning, predictive modeling, mathematical modeling, time series & forecasting, machine learning, optimization, statistics, probability modeling, regression analyses, Bayesian analysis, and different types of simulation to solve the nation's toughest problems. And our research pushes the boundaries on topics such as complex scheduling, medical image analysis, identifying changes in data streams and incorporating the latest AI advancements into our processes for efficiency and rigor.

If you are passionate about project-based analytical work in the public interest, you have found the right place.

Roles & Responsibilities:



Apply advanced analytical and mathematical modeling techniques to inform difficult policy and acquisition decisions, to maximize operational effectiveness and efficiency, and achieve highest quality engineering solutionsFrame problems, collect and manipulate data, develop & code customized algorithms, identify risks, and incorporate domain-specific context, as necessary & applicable, to supplement and enhance insight gained solely from mathematical analysesPresent results in an intuitive, actionable manner that can be understood by all sponsor audiences, regardless of technical expertise, including creative data visualization artifactsWork independently and collaborate with a team of technical staff and domain expertsWork successfully both in a remote environment and with in-person presence

Basic Qualifications:

 Typically requires less than 1 year of related experience with a related Bachelor's degree, or equivalent combination of related education and work experience.  Bachelor's degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Data Science/Analytics, Applied Mathematics/Statistics, or equivalent knowledge and skills in a related field  Be passionate about applying operations research, statistics, and data analytics to real world problems  Be willing to adapt and learn  Show evidence of knowledge of principles, concepts, methods and tools for conducting operations research, statistical analysis, and data analytic studies  Have experience in using tools and techniques to do mathematical modeling, optimization, statistics, probability modeling, and simulation  Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government's eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.  This position requires a minimum of 4 days a week on-site 

Preferred Qualifications:

 Demonstrated ability to use at least one optimization package (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, PuLP, AMPL)  Demonstrated ability to use at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, R, Java)  Demonstrated ability to use at least one simulation platform (e.g., Stella, Simio, Arena, AnyLogic, SimPy, RSimmer) Preference given to qualified candidates with active clearance (e.g. TS/SCI)Experience working with/for agencies and/or departments of the US Government (e.g., FAA, DoD, DoE, DHS, Treasury, IRS)Demonstrated ability to develop and incorporate a variety of AI/ML models, techniques, and principles into analytical work to efficiently achieve rigorous outcomes

None
